summary: Xtreme Fitness - Sales League Report - Change to Filter Logic
description_plain:
Change Sales League Report filter logic for group/location selection.

TC-01 — clear Location, select one group; Location/table shows clubs for that group only.
TC-02 — clear all groups; select two or more clubs from different groups; table shows only selected clubs.
TC-03 — groups cleared; select one club; table shows only that club.

Nikhila confirmed working as expected (10 Sep 2026).
Philip Dudley approved publish to customer-facing (14 Sep 2026).

Before: Xtreme Fitness Sales League does not support the requested no-group + multi-location selection behavior.
After: Xtreme Fitness keeps group-selected behavior and, with groups cleared, shows only selected clubs in Location.

Performance testing: Not performed/documented.
